exit_criteria.planned_evidence: The canonical matrix records an exact authoritative source and identity for every one of the twenty-four load-bearing surfaces.
Guarded source readers, exact output schemas and frozen unavailable representations prove every field is source-derived or explicitly unavailable.
Frozen JSON key order, CSV headers, report grammar, receipt schemas and commitment tuples reject unknown, missing, duplicate and reordered fields.
Trust Kernel lstat exact-tree admission covers source, staging, final and remote archive boundaries and rejects every unsupported path or entry type.
Accepted kernel and Stage 1 through Stage 4 unchanged claims bind their durable QA reports; every new H0-A surface declares that no prior version exists.
Current and frozen hostile runs execute every declared mutation id and assert its exact stable error code with fail-open count zero.
A content-addressed hostile-preflight receipt is completed before the first production-size source replay and is consumed by the formal runner.
